specification.title: Builder Live Preview Lifecycle
specification.goal: preview model during parameter changes before commit
specification.owner_rule: The named command is a GUI/command-line action only. Call the designated implementation owner; do not create a second geometry kernel or duplicate data stores.
specification.parent_scope: Builder panel, live preview, viewport control handles
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tạo geometry engine trong UI.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Builder Live Preview Lifecycle” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M04: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Builder Live Preview Lifecycle”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.
specification.execution_status: L4_PLANNED_NOT_EXECUTED; M00-M03 gates require real approval

m04_execution_handoff.test_policy: L4 source/design deliver documents; implement/integrate/regression/accept require actual code+test evidence

runtime_implementation.source_display_handoff_2026_11_14: Partial, compile-only: synchronous OCCT Builder preview retains its transient B-rep candidate and stages its display on Apply. Native production admission and preview lifetime accounting remain incomplete; no runtime acceptance is claimed. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-canonical-representation-transfer.md#builder-and-registered-history-handoff-in-progress

history_source_signatures_2026_11_14.scope: OCCT B-rep History and background Ring preview use source-derived topology signatures under a distinct namespace; Signet and Sweep checks cover remesh, while simulated UI and worker regressions pass.
history_source_signatures_2026_11_14.limitations: Old display-derived references need migration and cannot be safely auto-rebound; NativeBrep, cross-edit identity, native resource bounds, desktop and source-only ownership remain open.

source_topology_signatures_2026_11_14.scope: Source-derived OCCT topology measurements use explicit private shape-set references to preserve IDs in scoped Box and Sphere checks without retaining display.
source_topology_signatures_2026_11_14.limitations: Direct descriptor matching rejects a postmesh Box proof; the shape-set route is in-process and not integrated into History. Legacy references, native allocation and cancellation remain open.

ring_background_ui_2026_11_13.scope: OCCT MatrixApp ring-family previews use a cancellable worker, latest-edit queue and boundary overlay; headless fixtures cover Signet CMD, queued Apply and a Raised Band tab click.
ring_background_ui_2026_11_13.limitations: Desktop performance, toolbar menu route, other ring modes, shaded preview, source-only ownership and full lifecycle acceptance remain open.

ring_preview_apply_transfer_2026_11_13.scope: Explicit lease-backed ring preview can Apply through coordinator-registered staging; fixtures cover Undo/Redo, an external clone, History Record off and reopened Signet update.
ring_preview_apply_transfer_2026_11_13.limitations: The actual UI remains synchronous and does not poll or render the worker result; pressure, responsiveness and full lifecycle acceptance remain open.

ring_preview_lease_publication_2026_11_1.scope: An explicit controller call publishes a candidate as a lease-backed Builder preview; BRep clones, source owners and display pins retain the lease. Eleven worker fixtures and five BRep tests passed.
ring_preview_lease_publication_2026_11_1.limitations: Apply and Document insertion of the transient BRep are refused pending safe ownership transfer; UI routing, rendering, Undo and full lifecycle acceptance remain open.

ring_candidate_controller_2026_11_13.scope: Controller explicitly starts and polls a reserved ring candidate and rejects stale scene, document and Builder contexts; nine fixtures passed.
ring_candidate_controller_2026_11_13.limitations: Candidate remains private and is not installed or painted; UI polling, Apply/Undo and saved-tab preview ownership remain open.

ring_worker_staging_2026_11_13.scope: Internal ring job uses cancellable coordinator reservation growth and retains its result lease; six worker fixtures passed.
ring_worker_staging_2026_11_13.limitations: The job is not connected to Builder or UI; publication freshness, preview lease transfer, saved tabs and Apply/Undo remain unverified.

prepared_preview_publication_2026_11_13.scope: Prepared requests carry builder and document freshness tokens; fixtures cover stale results and off-thread production with owner-thread publication.
prepared_preview_publication_2026_11_13.limitations: Production Builder remains synchronous; worker cancellation, job and scene freshness, admission and retained-preview lifetime are not yet connected. Full lifecycle acceptance is not established.
